references.claim: Create events use the created branch/tag ref. Push uses the event ref's workflow; some other events require the default branch.
Commit skip instructions suppress push/pull_request workflows, not create.
Repository GITHUB_TOKEN push/create operations do not recursively trigger workflows. Current documentation separately lists dispatch and certain PR events; this proposal uses none of those.
Explicit permissions set omitted scopes to none; the proposal requests only contents write where publishing is needed.
Cross-run artifact API retrieval needs Actions read; initial authoring-only proposal does not require it.
